title: Update the Task Tracker
subtitle: One status record over four parallel branches
scenario: It is SD-1 afternoon. All four provisioning branches reported in. Roll their outcomes onto one tracker - each task's state, with a reason only when it is blocked. This single record is what the readiness gate reads to decide if the hire is ready.
input:
Branch outcomes for hire H-4021:
accounts -> created, complete
hardware -> delivered and confirmed, complete
access -> granted, complete
payroll -> enrolled and confirmed, complete
Allowed states: pending, in-progress, done, blocked. Set blockedReason only when a task is blocked; otherwise leave it empty.
instructions: Write one row per task: accounts, hardware, access, payroll.
Set each state to done (every branch completed).
Leave blockedReason empty for done tasks.
Return a JSON array of the four task-state rows, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Build a JSON array of four task-state rows (accounts, hardware, access, payroll). Each has taskId, state, and blockedReason. All four are done, so state is done and blockedReason is empty.
successMessage: Tracker updated. Four branches, one status record - the readiness gate can now read it.
editorHelper: One row per task - state now, reason only if blocked.

intro.heading: Before the gate: one record for four branches

sections.title: Parallel work needs one status
sections.body: Four branches ran at once. Without a single tracker, 'are we ready?' means chasing four people. The tracker collapses that into one record the gate can read in a glance.

sections.title: A fixed vocabulary of states
sections.body: States are not free text: pending, in-progress, done, blocked. A fixed vocabulary is what lets a machine gate on them. 'Almost done' is not a state the gate can act on.

sections.title: Blocked needs a reason
sections.body: A blocked task without a reason hides the very thing the gate and escalation need to see. Here every task is done, so blockedReason stays empty - but the field exists for the day it is not.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: One status record over four parallel branches. The readiness gate fans in on it; the medium tier sets one task to blocked to show what the gate does then.

fieldGuide.meaning: The provisioning task this row tracks.
fieldGuide.hint: One row each: accounts, hardware, access, payroll.

fieldGuide.meaning: The task's current state from the fixed vocabulary.
fieldGuide.hint: One of pending, in-progress, done, blocked. All four are done here.

fieldGuide.meaning: Why a task is blocked - empty unless blocked.
fieldGuide.hint: Leave it an empty string for done tasks.

takeaway.heading: Tracker updated
points: You rolled four parallel branches onto one status record.
States use a fixed vocabulary (pending, in-progress, done, blocked) the gate can act on.
blockedReason stays empty for done tasks but exists for when it is not.
All four tasks are done, so the gate has a clean record to read.
The workflow can now see four parallel branches in one status the gate reads.
